evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, render_service_text still identifies ExecStart directives with line.startswith('ExecStart='). systemd permits whitespace around '=', so a valid template line such as 'ExecStart = ...' yields zero matches and is rejected by the exact-one check. This is a concrete parser correctness defect in existing behavior, not a new requirement; the fix is a local directive recognition change, not an owner-level behavior change.
